description: This file contains shell functions and scripts related to testing and validating Git multi-pack index (midx) operations. It includes functions for consistency checks, checksum calculations, mode comparisons, and result comparisons involving the midx feature in Git.

methods.name: test_midx_consistent
methods.description: Checks the consistency of midx index files within a specified directory by comparing expected and actual index files and verifying with git

methods.name: midx_checksum
methods.description: Calculates checksum for a given midx index object

methods.name: midx_git_two_modes
methods.description: Compares the output of git commands run with midx feature enabled and disabled, optionally sorting the output

methods.name: compare_results_with_midx
methods.description: Runs multiple git commands with midx enabled and disabled to verify consistency of various operations
